Class RecordingSession

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.recording.RecordingSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
@ThreadSafe public final class RecordingSession extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Thread-safe MP4 video and audio recording, with H.264 encoding on a dedicated worker.

Video and audio may arrive independently, or together through capture(BufferedImage, byte[]). Inputs are copied before returning, so producers may reuse their buffers. Capture never waits for the worker; exceeding the bounded queue fails the session instead of slowing emulation or retaining unlimited frames. Check getFailure() when capture returns false.

Audio is signed 16-bit little-endian stereo PCM at the configured sample rate. Producers own frame pacing, synthesis and mixing. The session does not change audio samples or round the rational video frame rate.

stop(Path) and close() wait for the worker and file I/O. Call them off the UI thread.

  • Constructor Details

    • RecordingSession

      public RecordingSession(int width, int height, int videoScale, int videoRate, int audioSampleRate) throws IOException
      Creates one recording. Dimensions must be positive and even for H.264.
      Parameters:
      width - video width in pixels
      height - video height in pixels
      videoScale - frame-rate denominator
      videoRate - frame-rate numerator; fps = videoRate / videoScale
      audioSampleRate - stereo PCM frames per second
      Throws:
      IOException - if temporary recording files cannot be created
      IllegalArgumentException - if dimensions, frame rate or sample rate are invalid

  • Method Details

    • captureVideo

      public boolean captureVideo(BufferedImage frame)
      Captures one video frame. Null frames are ignored. Returns false if ignored, stopped or failed.

    • captureAudio

      public boolean captureAudio(byte[] pcmSamples, int length)
      Captures the first length bytes of PCM. Empty chunks are ignored; returns false if stopped or failed.
      Parameters:
      pcmSamples - PCM buffer, which may be reused after this call
      length - number of bytes, containing only whole stereo PCM frames
      Returns:
      whether capture was accepted
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an active producer passes a null buffer
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if length is outside the buffer

    • capture

      public boolean capture(BufferedImage frame, byte[] pcmSamples)
      Captures a video frame and its PCM together, in one queue entry. Both inputs are copied.

    • getFailure

      public IOException getFailure()
      Returns the capture failure, or null while healthy. Safe to poll from producer/UI threads.

    • stop

      public void stop(Path target) throws IOException
      Stops accepting capture and saves MP4 to target, or discards it when target is null. Saving drains accepted captures; discarding drops pending captures. Repeated calls do nothing. All temporary files are released, including after failed capture or export.
      Parameters:
      target - destination MP4, or null to discard
      Throws:
      IOException - if capture/export failed or stopping was interrupted

    • close

      public void close() throws IOException
      Discards this recording and releases its files. Blocks until the worker stops.
